HOW TO PLAY

TOUCH

LEFT THUMB drag anywhere on the left to steer · up = tuck · down = brake/carve hard

JUMP hold to crouch, release to pop (bigger charge, bigger air)

TRICK PAD swipe in 8 directions and hold for 8 grabs (diagonals: JAPAN · METHOD · STALEFISH · MUTE) · after landing push the stick ↑/↓ to manual and link the combo

BOOST burn your boost meter · in the air with a full TOURNAMENT bar = SUPER TRICK

In the air: steer = spin · stick up/down = flips

KEYBOARD / PAD

← → / A D steer & spin · ↑ ↓ / W S tuck/brake & flips

SPACE / Ⓐ hold & release to jump

J K L I / Ⓧ Ⓑ Ⓨ LB grabs (MELON · TAIL · INDY · NOSE) · press two for METHOD (L+J) · JAPAN (L+I) · STALEFISH (J+K) · MUTE (L+K) · after landing hold ↑/↓ to NOSE PRESS / MANUAL and keep the combo alive (steer while pressing = BUTTER)

SHIFT / RT boost · super trick in the air

ESC / START pause

SCORING

Spins 180–1080+, flips, corks, grabs (hold 0.7s for TWEAKED), rail slides. Land tricks within 2.3 s to chain a COMBO — the multiplier is the number of tricks.

Every big trick lights a letter of T·O·U·R·N·A·M·E·N·T. All 10 = infinite boost + your rider's signature super.

AUTO-LAND (on by default on touch) straightens your board before touchdown.
